name: gemma4-e4b-mi300x
description: Fast run: Gemma 4 E4B (effective ~4B parameters plus per-layer embeddings) on one MI300X. Minutes per epoch: run it first to validate the whole event pipeline, then launch the 31B run.
model_notes: Verify the exact Hub repo id and licence on the model card. Middle option: the 12B checkpoint with batch_size 4 / grad_accum 4.
Per-layer-embedding projections (per_layer_*) and audio/vision towers are never adapted; the detection summary lists them as excluded.

estimates.status: ESTIMATES ONLY - replace with measured numbers during 12-18 Oct
estimates.memory: bf16 weights incl. per-layer embeddings ~15-20 GB; activations at 8 x 8192 with checkpointing ~20-30 GB; expected peak well under 80 GB.
estimates.wall_clock_per_epoch: ~5-15 min for ~6M tokens (6 x ~4e9 effective x 6e6 = ~1.4e17 FLOPs at an assumed 15-30% MFU).
